Linggo (September 14, 2025)

𝗠𝗮𝗸𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗺𝗹𝗶𝗺 𝗻𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗽𝗮𝘄𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻 𝗻𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘆 𝗽𝗮𝗯𝘂𝗴𝘀𝘂-𝗯𝘂𝗴𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝘂𝗹𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗺 ang inaasahan ngayong Linggo dahil sa Low Pressure Area (LPA) na tatawirin ang Luzon ngayong araw. Mag-ingat sa posibleng mga localized flooding.

EPEKTO NG LPA SA METRO MANILA: 

🌧 Inaasahan ang 𝗺𝗮𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗮 𝗸𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗺𝘁𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝘁 𝗽𝗮𝗯𝘂𝗴𝘀𝘂-𝗯𝘂𝗴𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗸𝗮𝘀 𝗻𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗴-𝘂𝗹𝗮𝗻

ℹ️ MABABA ang tiyansa na magdulot ng malawakang pagbaha, ngunit 𝗺𝗮𝘆 𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱 𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗱 𝗻𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗯𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝘀𝗮 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗯𝗮𝗵𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗹𝘂𝗴𝗮𝗿. 

🌬️ Mahina hanggang sa minsang malakas na bugso ng hangin

ℹ️ 𝗠𝗔𝗕𝗔𝗕𝗔 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗮 𝗻𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝗴𝗱𝘂𝗹𝗼𝘁 𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮 𝘀𝗮 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗿𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗸𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗮

IBA PANG DAPAT MALAMAN: 

➡️ Ang sentro ng Low Pressure Area (LPA) ay huling namataan ng PAGASA sa Castilla, Sorsogon, kaninang 3:00 AM, ngunit ang makakapal na kaulapan nito ay umaabot na sa atin.

➡️ Ang nasabing LPA ay inaasahang tatawid ng Southern Luzon ngayong araw at magdudulot ng mga pag-uulan sa malaking bahagi ng Luzon.

➡️ Dahil sa easterlies, posibleng hanggang sa Lunes o Martes pa maging makulimlim ang panahon sa Metro Manila.

ℹ️ Manatiling updated at alerto sa lagay ng panahon sa ating barangay. Ingat po!

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 14 September 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Burdeos, Catanauan, General Luna, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Polillo, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Unisan) and Laguna(San Pablo, Nagcarlan, Rizal, Majayjay, Liliw, Luisiana, Cavinti, Lumban, Paete, Pakil, Kalayaan, Pagsanjan, Santa Cruz, Magdalena, Pila, Victoria, Calauan, Siniloan, Famy, Pangil).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite and Batangas within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta), Laguna(Mabitac, Alaminos, Bay, Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Los Banos, Binan, San Pedro, Santa Maria), Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon, General Tinio) and Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
